invented_facts: The workstation removes dependency on cloud infrastructure for core development tasks.
The battery specifications ensure all-day operation during site visits or off-grid work; the cited battery figure is only for local video playback under specified conditions.
The port selection eliminates the need for dongles when connecting to external monitors, storage devices, or presentation equipment.
A demo unit can be requested.
notes: The post has the requested structure and addresses IT decision-makers, but several operational promises go beyond the spec sheet. Qualifying those claims would make it closer to send-ready.
